name: Operations Research
description:
Linear programming
- Modeling linear programs
- Simplex algorithm, revised simplex method
- Sensitivity analysis and duality
Integer linear programming
- Modeling and solution methods of integer optimization problems (complexity theory, branch and bound, cutting planes)
- Matroids, total unimodularity
- Network flow problems and graph algorithms (e.g. Hungarian algorithm, cycle-canceling algorithm)
- TSP and approximation algorithms
Nonlinear optimization
- Gradient methods
- Constrained convex optimization (Lagrange approach, KKT conditions)
- Online Optimization
